name: ui-tap-ripple
title: Tap Ripple
description: Mỗi lần chạm, một vòng sáng mờ loang ra từ đúng điểm chạm tới góc xa nhất của nút rồi tan, chỉ nằm trong nút.

moworks.author: takayu

options.grow: s to the farthest corner (0.55, power2.out)
options.dot: px radius of the touch mark (30)
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-tap-ripple, written here): Accent button 160x52, radius 14. Each tap: a light ink circle (#e8ebf3) at the tap point, radius 0 → distance of the farthest corner in 550 ms power2.out, opacity 38 % fading to 0 from 200 to 750 ms after the tap, clipped to the button. Two taps 1.1 s apart at different points (0.55 s left-low, 1.65 s right-high); a small touch dot (r3 + ring r6) marks each tap for 0.35 s. Params: taps [[giây, x, y]] · grow (0.55 s, power2.out) · opacity (0.38) · fade (0.2 → 0.75 s).
moworks.titleVi: Gợn sáng loang từ điểm chạm
